title: Clo At Cisma 2025!
description: What an incredible week at #CISMA 2025! We were thrilled to showcase our end-to-end digital solutions for the fashion industry — from design to production — and connect with so many inspiring professionals across the field! 🚀
transcript: The advantages of CLO are that we can understand the core points and needs of brands, manufacturers, and fabric manufacturers. Through a one-piece solution, we can break the confluence of information. CLO's newly released automated fabric measurement software can optimize the entire testing process by using a large amount of fabric data and AI technology. So that our users can easily build high-quality fabric data with unprecedented efficiency and accuracy. So that the fabric speed is no longer a threshold, but a starting point for high efficiency and cohesion. CLO's new 2025 version brings new functions to upgrade and optimize. The core highlights include the highly integrated CLO AI Studio. Here you can temporarily experience all the AI functions. For example, the AI automatic production version which includes the fabric, texture, texture, posture, and so on. At the same time, CLO has added the B-Zone cowhide water wash so that customers can easily use different water wash techniques. And the seamless division function allows customers to apply different fabrics on the same board to achieve a more smooth seamless design. This fully assists enterprises in achieving design innovations and development proposals. New AI is changing the world.
markdown_content: ## Overview of CLO’s Advantages and Fabric Measurement Software This section covers CLO’s integrated solutions for brands, manufacturers, and fabric producers, focusing on automated fabric measurement and AI-driven data optimization. CLO provides a unified platform that addresses the core needs of brands, manufacturers, and fabric suppliers by consolidating fragmented information into a single solution. Their newly released automated fabric measurement software leverages extensive fabric data combined with artificial intelligence to optimize the entire fabric testing process. This enables users to efficiently create high-quality fabric data with exceptional accuracy. The technology shifts fabric speed from being a limiting factor to a starting point for improved efficiency and cohesion across workflows. ## Features and Innovations in CLO 2025 This section details the key new features introduced in CLO’s 2025 version, including AI integration, water wash techniques, and seamless fabric application. The 2025 release of CLO introduces several significant upgrades: - **Highly Integrated CLO AI Studio**: This environment allows users to experiment with various AI-powered functions such as automatic production versioning. AI capabilities now cover aspects including fabric properties, texture detail, and posture simulation to enhance design accuracy and realism. - **B-Zone Cowhide Water Wash**: This new feature offers different water wash treatments for cowhide materials, enabling customers to apply diverse finishing techniques easily. - **Seamless Division Function**: Users can now apply multiple fabric types on a single garment panel (board) seamlessly. This helps realize smoother, more sophisticated designs without visible fabric transitions. Together, these updates support enterprises in accelerating design innovation and improving product development proposals through advanced AI and fabric simulation technologies. ## Impact of AI on Fashion Design and Fabric Development This final section emphasizes how CLO’s AI capabilities are transforming fabric data management and fashion design workflows. The integration of AI into CLO’s platform is revolutionizing the way fabric characteristics are measured, modeled, and applied in digital garment creation. By automating complex data processing and enabling precise fabric simulations, CLO empowers designers and manufacturers to innovate rapidly while maintaining high-quality standards. The platform’s AI-driven tools facilitate cohesive collaboration between brands, fabric mills, and manufacturers, driving forward the future of fashion technology.
